question: A money lender finds that due to the fall in the annual rate of interest from 18% to 15%, his yearly income diminishes by Rs. 750. His capital is:
solution:

Annual rate of interest decreased from 18% to 15%.

Yearly income diminishes by Rs. 750.

Interest = (Principal × Rate × Time) / 100

Difference in income = Interest with first-rate - Interest with second-rate
